name: skybuild-3d-tower-crane-simulator
description: SkyBuild 3D: Tower Crane & Construction Simulator built with Three.js & Tailwind CSS by Md Mujahidul Islam

scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); ['public', 'dist'].forEach(d => { fs.mkdirSync(d, {recursive:true}); fs.copyFileSync('index.html', d + '/index.html'); if(fs.existsSync('robots.txt')) fs.copyFileSync('robots.txt', d + '/robots.txt'); if(fs.existsSync('sitemap.xml')) fs.copyFileSync('sitemap.xml', d + '/sitemap.xml'); }); console.log('Build completed: public & dist ready.');"
